description: Death-soaked reaper who snowballs through kills, souls, and grim harvest milestones.

presentation.headline: Reaper-style caster who snowballs through kills and soul pressure.
presentation.fantasy_hook: Heavier necromantic pressure that grows stronger the more the wave feeds the harvest.
presentation.identity_summary: The Harvester mixes reaping blades and grim necromantic shots into a heavier, more methodical offense. He wants kills to keep momentum up and feels strongest when waves start feeding the harvest.
presentation.passive_summary: Enemy kills fill a five-soul harvest. Completing it unleashes a short Soul Surge that empowers necromancy and curse weapons.
strengths: Strong identity for slower methodical play
tradeoffs: Starts weaker than pure tempo builds
Less immediate burst than fast ranged characters
